dog.description_text:
Hi, I’m Primrose! I’m a 1-year-old mutt with a whole lot of love to give. I’m kind, curious, and gentle, and I love getting to know the world around me. My favorite thing to do is go on walks and sniff absolutely everything! I’m also starting to warm up to other dogs and would love to make some new friends for playdates.

I almost never bark, havent chewed or eaten anything I’m not supposed to, and am house trained. I’m also low-shedding, so I won’t leave too much of my fur around your home.

When it’s time for bed, I settle in nicely and sleep peacefully in my crate through the night. I’m happy and love exploring, spending time with my people, and soaking up all the love I can get. I’m still young and have so much to learn and experience, and I can’t wait to find my forever home.
dog.name: Primrose
